user_story: As a user, I want to see the content load asynchronously when I click the 'Start' button, so that I can verify the dynamic loading functionality works correctly. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I visit the page at 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/dynamic_loading/1', I can see the button with the text 'Start' inside the div with id 'start'. 2. After clicking the 'Start' button, I should see the div with id 'finish' containing the text 'Hello World!'.
